Sat 22 + Sun 23 August 2026.

The numbers are still placeholders — the amber strip at the top says so, and it turns green once a real source is wired in.

This sandbox cannot reach any weather host, so the forecast could not be fetched here. Run fetch-forecast.mjs from a normal machine and the strip flips to "Live · Open-Meteo".

Two alternate directions, kept low-fi on purpose — they are here to argue with, not to ship.

The built version above is the warm-editorial direction: flat vector scenes, cream ground, one accent per place — vine green, Baltic blue, Warsaw brick.

Say which one you want and I will build it into the main artboards.
